description: Prior approval for the erection of an additional floor extension to provide 10 residential units
application_type_full: Prior Approval: New dwellinghouses on detached buildings in commercial or mixed use
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Time limit 

The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.

Reason: To accord with the provisions of paragraph AA.2 (3), of Part 20, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 2 - In accordance with approved plans 

The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A_PL_EX_001 Rev P01, A_PL_EX_002 Rev P01, A_PL_EX_099 Rev P02, A_PL_EX_100 Rev P02, A_PL_EX_101 Rev P01, A_PL_EX_102 Rev P01, A_PL_EX_103 Rev P01, A_PL_EX_300 Rev P01, A_PL_EX_301 Rev P01, A_PL_EX_302 Rev P01, A_PL_EX_313 Rev P01, A_PL_EX_323 Rev P03, A_PL_PR_082 Rev P01, A_PL_PR_179 Rev P02, A_PL_PR_180 Rev P02, A_PL_PR_181 Rev P01, A_PL_PR_182 Rev P01, A_PL_PR_183 Rev P01, A_PL_PR_184 Rev P01, A_PL_PR_380 Rev P02, A_PL_PR_381 Rev P02, A_PL_PR_382 Rev P02, A_PL_PR_383 Rev P02, A_PL_PR_384 Rev P01, Daylight and Sunlight Report (Neighbouring Properties), Daylight and Sunlight Report (Within Development), Flood Risk Assessment, Planning Cover Letter, Planning Noise and Vibration Assessment and Phase 1 Geo-Environmental Due Diligence Risk Assessment. Received: 18/06/2026; A_SK_260729_002 Rev 00 (Section - Distances to Neighbours) and Transport Assessment. Received: 31/07/2026) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the
agreed details and to accord with the provisions of Paragraph B, Part 20, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 3 - Materials

The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.
Condition : 4 - Restrictions on use

The hereby permitted dwellinghouses are to remain in use as a dwellinghouses within the meaning of Class C3 of Schedule 1 to the Use Classes Order and for no other purpose, except to the extent that the other purpose is ancillary to the use as a dwellinghouse.

Reason: To accord with the provisions of Paragraph B, Part 20, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 5 - Planning Application Implementation

The hereby approved development shall not commence until approved
planning permission reference P/2026/0284 dated 27 March 2026 is
fully implemented in strict accordance with the approved plans.

Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 6 - Car Parking Management Plan

Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, a Car Parking Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority for that phase. The Plan shall include the following:

(i)	Measures to remove existing parking spaces as part of the approved development (except for 3 Blue Badge parking spaces), including a layout plan clearly showing all designated Blue Badge parking spaces, pedestrian and cycle routes, and areas where parking is not permitted. The Plan shall also include measures to restrict parking for residents of the approved development (other than Blue Badge holders), and how these restrictions will be managed, operated, and enforced.

(ii)	Measures to ensure that all prospective residents are informed of the Parking Management Plan and that all future residents will not be assigned a parking space or a right to park within the development other than blue badge holders.

(iii)	Details of the operation of any gates or barriers.

The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details and shall be maintained for the lifetime of the development, unless the prior written approval of the local planning authority is obtained to secure any variation.

Reason: In order to control the level and usage of parking on the site and to support sustainable transport objectives. To accord with the provisions of Paragraph B, Part 20, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 7 - Construction Logistics Plan

No development shall take place, including any works of demolition, until a Construction Logistics Plan that conforms to current TfL and CLOCS guidance has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The approved Plan shall be adhered to throughout the construction period. The Plan shall include:

i.	a site plan (showing the areas set out below); 
ii.	confirmation that a pre-start record of site conditions on the adjoining public highway will be undertaken with Hounslow Highways and a commitment to repair any damage caused; 
iii.	provision for the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors;
iv.	provisions for loading, unloading and storage of plant and materials within the site;
v.	details of access to the site, including means to control and manage access and egress of vehicles to and from the site for the duration of construction including phasing arrangements;
vi.	details of vehicle routeing from the site to the wider strategic road network;
vii.	the erection and maintenance of security hoarding including decorative displays and facilities for public viewing, where appropriate;
viii.	provision of wheel washing facilities at the site exit and a commitment to sweep adjacent roads when required and at the request of the Council;
ix.	a scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works;
x.	measures to ensure the safety of all users of the public highway especially cyclists and pedestrians in the vicinity of the site and especially at the access;
xi.	commitment to liaise with other contractors in the vicinity of the site to maximise the potential for consolidation and to minimise traffic impacts;
xii.	commitment for all deliveries to take place between 09:30-15:00 (outside peak hours) and details of a booking system to avoid vehicles waiting on the public highway;
xiii.	all necessary traffic orders and other permissions required to allow safe ac
Condition : 8 - Delivery and Servicing Plan

Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, a Delivery & Servicing Plan (including details of vehicle access and egress arrangements and times that servicing shall take place) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall accord with current guidance such as that issued by TfL and include measures required to ensure sufficient arrangements (physical as well as managerial) for the servicing, including refuse collection, of all aspects of the development, the timing of hours for deliveries by motor vehicles and a timetable for implementation. The plan shall set out how larger delivery vehicles will be prevented from servicing the site, identify the types and sizes of vehicles expected to serve the development and include measures to ensure that all deliveries and servicing can be accommodated safely without causing obstruction or disruption to the public highway.

The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details and shall be maintained for the lifetime of the development, unless the prior written approval of the local planning authority is obtained to any variation.

Reason: In the interests of the safety of pedestrians and vehicles, to protect neighbours' living conditions and to support sustainable transport objectives. To accord with the provisions of Paragraph B, Part 20, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 9 - Road Safety Audit and access

Prior to first occupation of the dwellings, details of highway works at the site access, including Road Safety Audit Stage 2, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 

The highway works shall include appropriate measures to ensure that pedestrian priority and safety would be secured. 

Works shall be carried out in accordance with the agreed details prior to first occupation of the dwellings. 

Reason: In the interest of highway and pedestrian safety at the site access. In accordance with the provisions of Paragraph B, Part 20, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 10 - Cycle Parking 

Notwithstanding the submitted details and prior to first occupation of the hereby permitted dwellings, full details (including manufacturers' specifications) of secure covered cycle parking facilities that accord with the TfL London Cycling Design Standards and West London Cycle Parking Guidance for 30 cycle parking spaces (for the office use), 18 cycle parking spaces (for the residential use) and 6 cycle parking spaces (for visitors) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 

The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before the development is first occupied or brought into use, The approved facilities shall be thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives, in accordance with the provisions of Paragraph B, Part 20, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 11 - Refuse and recycling

The approved refuse and recycling storage as shown on approved drawing no. A_PL_PR_180 Rev P02 shall be completed and made available for use before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use and thereafter shall be always retained for such use without obstruction. Bins shall remain within the store at all times and only brought out onto the public highway when refuse is collected and shall not be left on the public highway.

Reason: To protect the quality of the local environment and to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the public highway. In accordance with the provisions of Paragraph B, Part 20, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 12 - Parking Permit Restriction

The development shall not be occupied until arrangements have been agreed in writing with the local planning authority and put in place to ensure that, except for disabled persons, no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit within any controlled parking zone which may be in force in the area at any time.

Reason: To protect the free flow and safety of traffic on nearby highways and to support sustainable transport objectives. In accordance with the provisions of Paragraph B, Part 20, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 13 - All Non-Road Mobile Machinery (NRMM)

All Non-Road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) of net power of between 37kW and 560kW (inclusive) used during the course of the demolition, site preparation and construction phases of the development hereby approved shall comply with the emission standards set out in chapter 7 of the GLA's supplementary planning guidance (SPG) 'Control of Dust and Emissions During Construction and Demolition' dated July 2014, or subsequent replacement guidance. Unless it complies with the standards set out in the SPG, no NRMM shall be on site, at any time, whether in use or not. The developer shall keep an up to date list of all NRMM used during the demolition, site preparation and construction phases of the development on the online register at https://nrmm.london/.

The development shall also demonstrate that the proposed development is compliant with Building Emissions Benchmark (BEBs), specified in the GLA's Supplementary Planning Guidance "Sustainable Design and Construction" dated April 2014), or subsequent replacement guidance.

Reason: To minimise air pollution in the interests of air quality and the wider local environment.
Condition : 14 - Construction Noise Limits and Permitted Hours of work

Based upon guidance contained within BS 5228:2009 + A1:2014: Noise, Noise levels from construction works at nearby existing and proposed residential receptors shall not exceed the following construction noise criteria: Daytime works will not exceed 75 dB LAeq,T at the worst-affected residential property during the following time periods: 
�	Monday to Friday (08:00 to 18:00 hours) 

�	Saturday (08:00 to 13:00 hours) Works outside of the standard hours will be subject to prior agreement and prior notice will be provided to the London Borough of Hounslow. 

Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions. To accord with the provisions of Paragraph B, Part 20, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 15 - Sound insulation details (external noise source)

(a)	No development (except any demolition, site clearance, ground investigation and remediation work) shall take place until details have been submitted to and approved by the local planning authority of a scheme providing for the insulation of the proposed dwellings against the transmission of externally generated aircraft, road and rail noise (and vibration), taking account of any ventilation requirements necessary, in order to ensure that the maximum noise levels permitted within the dwellings will not exceed those that are specified in Table 4 of British Standard 8233:2014 [Living Rooms = 35 dB LAeq, 16 hours; Dining room/area = 40 dB LAeq, 16 hours; Bedroom = 35 dB LAeq, 16 hours during day-time (07:00 - 23:00) and Bedroom = 30 dB LAeq, 8 hours during night-time (23:00 - 07:00)], or any equivalent standards if replaced.

(b)	Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, post-completion noise tests shall be carried out by accredited/approved organisations with competence in environmental noise assessments for residential accommodation and test reports shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Noise tests shall be carried out taking account of worst-case environmental conditions, such as easterly operations at Heathrow, peak time traffic flows, wind speed and direction and presence of temperature inversion. Continuous logged data shall be submitted.

Reason: In order to secure acceptable living conditions for residents of the new dwellings. To accord with the provisions of Paragraph B, Part 20, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
